item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-11-28 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 18 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (9). Mitel has the most new KEV entries this week (5). CVE-2026-16232 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 894 positions.
